data.name: Muizzat
data.gender_notes: Muizzat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Muizzat is an Arabic name that means 'one who is protected by Allah'. It is a name that symbolizes safety and security under the guardianship of the Almighty. The name Muizzat carries the meaning “Protected by Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muizzat usually hope their child will grow to embody protected by allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In the Quran, Allah says, 'And whoever fears Allah, He will make for him a way out, and will provide for him from where he does not expect' (Quran 65:2-3).
data.etymology: Muizzat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protected by Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muizzat total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

Historically, names with such connotations have been used to reflect spiritual aspirations and to invoke divine blessings. Muizzat embodies a profound spiritual significance, reflecting the aspiration to attain closeness to Allah and to be a source of honour and dignity.
